items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Paul 'Hucklebuck' Williams came through there, needed a bass player... I got on the bus and left with Paul 'Hucklebuck' Williams. OK. Now everybody in Paul Williams band is--is--is--raw men.

ctx.x: He said, "anytime you get ready to come." I said, "well, I'm ready now." So he said, "I'll send you a ticket. So I caught the Silver Meteor. My bass, bags, and he met me at the station down there, man. No-no--no--
I'm going too fast. I'm going too fast. I left Florida with Paul "Hucklebuck" Williams.
